question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Imminent
solution:
The correct answer is '**Impending**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Imminent**' is '**Impending**'.
 
• **Imminent**: (usually used about something unpleasant) almost certain to happen very soon. [(प्रायः अप्रिय बात) बहुत शीघ्र लगभग निश्‍चित रूप से घटित होने वाली; सन्निकट, आसन्‍न, अवश्‍यंभावी]
 
 
• *Example: Heavy rainfall means that flooding is **imminent**.*
 
 
 
• **Impending**: (usually used about something bad) that will happen soon. [(अशुभ घटना) जो शीघ्र घटित होगी, आसन्‍न, सन्निकट]
 
 
• *Example: There was a feeling of **impending** disaster in the air.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Impending.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Ignorant**: not knowing about something. [(किसी बात से) अनजान, अनभिज्ञ]
 
• **Unyielding**: (of a mass or structure) not giving way to pressure; hard or solid. ((किसी द्रव्यमान या संरचना का) दबाव को रास्ता नहीं देना; कठोर या ठोस)
 
• **Distant**: a long way away in space or time. (स्‍थान या समय की दृष्टि से काफ़ी दूर)
